text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we decided to put a lock on
the cupboard just to be safe, ya know.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, how about
I attach that key for ya?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh, ya sure?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn straight! A bit of DIY is a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Inari-san, pardon me for asking, but would you
be able to come by my room afterwards?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I bumped into the door while practicing,
and now the frame is all warped...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Did ya mess up? No problem at all,
I'm on my way, just hold tight!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Inari~! My bed broke!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"You did it again?!
How many times do I have to tell you that jumping all over the place ain't a game?!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooorry...
Could you please fix it again...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't you go whinin' like that!
Fixin' up a bed is a piece of cake for me!
Leave it all to yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way, make way!
If you daydream, you're gonna get hit by the timber!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're at it, I'll make it
even tougher than before!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Aaah!
Tea after doing carpentry work tastes extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Having it done so quickly was a huge help!
The rest of the Disciplinary Committee was super happy, too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh! That's the best news I could hear!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's happy too!
I can jump on the bed like a trampoline again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Jump around and make some noise!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful.
I would love the chance to repay your kindness, if possible.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks! For me,
your smiles are the best reward of all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Besides, doing all those different jobs worked out muscles I don't normally use, so it ended up being great practice!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is totally gonna pay off in my running!
Can't wait to test it out in my next race!
